overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly targeted and engaged social media presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated inauthentic behavior. Across all channels, professional milestones such as grant announcements, job openings, and tool releases generate robust interaction, indicating a highly relevant academic and professional audience.

contentThemes.description: Discussions, research papers, and conference presentations on computational methods for identifying disinformation campaigns.
Recruitment drives for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Updates on proprietary research tools and algorithms, such as the release of CooRnet v2.0.

recommendations: Capitalize on LinkedIn's high volume of professional contacts by using it as the primary channel for recruitment and funding announcements.
Increase posting frequency on Bluesky and Mastodon to take advantage of high niche audience engagement and active academic communities.
Utilize rich media, threads, or direct external links to further drive conversion rates and interactions on research-focused posts.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest average engagement rate per post (6.14%), driven by strong sharing behavior (reposts) within the academic community, especially regarding new papers and student opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides a highly concentrated and responsive audience (4.55% average engagement) with a strong preference for technical tool updates like CooRnet.
platformInsights.linkedin: Serves as the high-reach foundation with 1,850 followers. It yields the highest absolute volume of interactions, particularly for organizational milestones and recruitment campaigns.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
Excited to announce that our research team has been awarded a new grant to study information operations across social media platforms.
Our team has just released v2.0 of CooRnet, with improved algorithms for detecting coordinated link sharing behavior.
